# Auto-generated PING services can be disabled

key        | value
---------- | ---
date       | 2026-08-21T05:17:35.077916+00:00
version    | 2.4.0p37
class      | fix
edition    | cre
component  | config
level      | 1
compatible | no

When dual-stack host is monitored, it will conditionally receive a *PING IPv4* service or a *PING IPv6*.

Prior to this change, these services could only be replaced but not disabled.

Now, the *Disabled services* rule is applied to either service, for either the Checkmk Micro Core or Nagios Core.

The fallback *PING* service is not affected. A host needs at least one service, and
that is the only one such a host has.

### Does this affect you?

Only if you already have a *Disabled services* rule whose service condition matches
*PING*, *PING IPv4* or *PING IPv6*. If so, prior ping services may disappear.

Check your *Disabled services* rules for these patterns before updating, and restrict
the condition if you want to keep monitoring the secondary address family.
